originalFinding.aspect: P01 complete readable wrapping; P05 notes control clipping
originalFinding.claim: At fontScale 2.0, the notes disclosure clips caller title glyphs against its rounded clickable shape. C03 loses the leading R of Read and the leading letters of instructions; C06 clips the right ends of déposer and colis. The problem appears in both expanded and collapsed states.
reasons: The native C03 Text layout reports the full caller string, four lines, overflow=false and ellipsized=false, while actual pixels visibly omit glyph parts. Layout flags alone therefore do not establish unclipped drawing.
The TextButton has no explicit shape override and zero content padding; a rounded button clip is the suspected cause.
originalFinding.repairRecommendation: Use a rectangular/unclipped text-led clickable Row, or explicitly give the disclosure a non-capsule shape while retaining its button role, 44-unit minimum target, full label and controlled callback. Check other multiline TextButton labels for the same clipping mechanism.

originalScope.aspect: P01 complete readable wrapping; P05 notes control clipping

originalFinding.aspect: P05 disabled action colors and disabled option/size legibility
originalFinding.claim: Native disabled buttons dim their entire custom content. The disabled primary does not render the prescribed fills/text, and unavailable options and sizes visibly fade their caller text and reason.
reasons: C01 disabled primary dominant fill is RGB(239,242,240), compared with required (223,230,225): maximum channel difference 16 exceeds 12. Its dominant glyph color is (164,171,167), compared with (89,101,94).
C02/C04 dark disabled primary fill is (39,51,48), compared with required (52,68,60); glyph color is (113,126,120), compared with (186,200,192).
C04 disabled option fill remains the card color (25,34,36), but secondary text resolves to (103,113,112) rather than (180,192,187), and main text to (134,140,140) rather than (242,246,243).
C02 unavailable size text/reason and C03 disabled action are visibly dimmed. The source combines PlainButtonStyle with .disabled; default disabled appearance is the likely mechanism.
originalFinding.repairRecommendation: Use a custom ButtonStyle that preserves the authored label and fill colors when disabled, while retaining native disabled state and guards against callbacks. Apply it consistently to options, sizes, and primary actions.

originalScope.aspect: P05 disabled action colors and disabled option/size legibility

originalFinding.aspect: P01 natural-flow geometry; P07 per-state full-content evidence
originalFinding.claim: With unchanged input and event binding, native content height changes during the initial scroll sweep from 8314.67 to 8266.67 points. The acknowledgement moves upward by 48 points in content coordinates. The supplied initial-state sweep is therefore not stable complete-content evidence.
reasons: The state capture explicitly reports complete=false and stable_height=false, despite bottom_reached=true and max_gap=0.
The input hash, fixture index 0, event revision 0, process and instance remain unchanged throughout this sweep. rr.ack moves from content Y5649 to Y5601.
The size controls first obtain finite measured frames at snapshot21, when the first height change occurs. LazyVGrid measurement is a suspected cause, not established by the native export.
originalFinding.repairRecommendation: Investigate eager size layout, especially for the one-column accessibility mode, so reserving space does not change as offscreen cells appear. Re-capture this state before claiming complete visual coverage.

originalFinding.aspect: P05 disabled action colors and disabled option/size legibility
originalFinding.claim: Native disabled buttons dim their entire custom content. The disabled primary does not render the prescribed fills/text, and unavailable options and sizes visibly fade their caller text and reason.
reasons: C01 disabled primary dominant fill is RGB(239,242,240), compared with required (223,230,225): maximum channel difference 16 exceeds 12. Its dominant glyph color is (164,171,167), compared with (89,101,94).
C02/C04 dark disabled primary fill is (39,51,48), compared with required (52,68,60); glyph color is (113,126,120), compared with (186,200,192).
C04 disabled option fill remains the card color (25,34,36), but secondary text resolves to (103,113,112) rather than (180,192,187), and main text to (134,140,140) rather than (242,246,243).
C02 unavailable size text/reason and C03 disabled action are visibly dimmed. The source combines PlainButtonStyle with .disabled; default disabled appearance is the likely mechanism.
originalFinding.repairRecommendation: Use a custom ButtonStyle that preserves the authored label and fill colors when disabled, while retaining native disabled state and guards against callbacks. Apply it consistently to options, sizes, and primary actions.

unverifiableSubclaims.claim: Disabled primary colors in C03 initial/open and C04 initial/new-purchase; unavailable option/size text and reasons in C02/C04.
unverifiableSubclaims.rationale: These explicitly described subclaims do not have same-target/same-state disabled color probes in the frozen D0 atomic matrix. C04 header/card color probes and legible-string/native-enabled assertions concern different conditions. No nearby PASS is treated as FP and no related FAIL is credited.

unverifiableSubclaims.claim: Default disabled appearance is the likely source mechanism.
unverifiableSubclaims.rationale: Source mechanism speculation does not establish any additional runtime style member.

originalFinding.aspect: P05 resolved native typography; P06 disclosure/busy/heading/decorative semantics
originalFinding.claim: Actual disclosure state descriptions, progress busy descriptions, heading traits, decorative accessibility suppression, resolved font family and actual native scaling remain unassessed from this export.
reasons: Exported node fields include font_sp/font_weight/color_argb, but no resolved font family or scaling metrics, heading flag, stateDescription, or generic value.
The 245 notes-value checks with absent export fields are explicitly null/unassessed, not product failures. Source declarations do not replace runtime observations.
Android activations are native semantic OnClick operations; physical OS touch and screen-reader activation were not demonstrated.

unverifiableSubclaims.claim: Android physical OS touch and screen-reader activation not demonstrated; native OnClick was used.
unverifiableSubclaims.rationale: No specific activation-checkpoint state is listed in this finding. The full-state list is not silently expanded to every action member; actual OnClick facts remain in the sealed grade.

originalFinding.aspect: P05 resolved typography; P06 heading/decorative traits and actual hit regions/AX activation
originalFinding.claim: Resolved font family, base glyph size and actual native scaling, heading traits, complete decorative-element suppression, physical hit regions, and accessibility performAction activation remain unassessed.
reasons: The iOS export contains AX labels, roles, values, selected/enabled state and frames, without resolved font metrics or heading traits.
Frame checks establish only AX boundary dimensions. They do not establish physical hit regions. The adapter executes XCUI tap, not accessibility performAction.
Requested/actual SwiftUI category and enlarged visible glyphs do not by themselves establish the required resolved native-font instrumentation.

unverifiableSubclaims.rationale: The finding names the method/category but does not name individual controls of the parameterized touch-target group. Preserve the group-level limitation without automatically claiming every mandatory member.

unverifiableSubclaims.claim: Accessibility performAction activation remains unassessed; adapter executes XCUI tap.
unverifiableSubclaims.rationale: The finding lists full-state checkpoints, not exact activation checkpoint states. No action-member expansion or product failure is invented.

unverifiableClaims.claim: A rounded TextButton clip is the suspected cause; check other multiline TextButton labels.
unverifiableClaims.rationale: The cause and other controls were not confirmed and do not claim the radius/spacing predicates or additional state/member failures.

unverifiableClaims.claim: Disabled primary colors in C03 initial/open and C04 initial/new-purchase; unavailable option/size text and reasons in C02/C04.

C04 header/card color probes and legible-string/native-enabled assertions concern different conditions. No nearby PASS is treated as FP and no related FAIL is credited.

negativeAndCoverageClaims.nativeCheckScope: Counts are repeated snapshot-level assertions, not independent requirements and not a whole-contract pass. Checks cover gate labels, primary/keep names and enabled state, effective option/size selected and enabled states, complete accessible option/size names when native controls exist, acknowledgement state/name, iOS disclosure values, status exclusions, and minimum fully-visible native bounds within the exported measurement scope.
negativeAndCoverageClaims.callbackAndControlScope: Each platform has 42 observed steps: 15 actual callbacks and three disabled controls blocked with zero delta, plus 24 sweep/replacement steps. Exact expected callback payloads, current fixture index, and same-instance binding matched these supplied sequences. This does not cover actions or combinations absent from C01-C06.
negativeAndCoverageClaims.nativeIdentifiers: Expected identifiers were found in the per-input native node unions for all 17 supplied input states on each platform. This does not prove unique region wrapper geometry or visual readability, and lazy offscreen controls are not assumed to exist in every snapshot.
negativeAndCoverageClaims.visualScope: All 26 listed derived montage files were inspected. C01,C02,C04,C05 initial and explicitly swept replacement states use every snapshot of their listed sweeps. C03 and the long C06 editing states were sampled at six listed snapshots each, not reviewed at every scroll interval. Android C06 submitting uses all six supplied sweep snapshots. Full-content visual acceptance is withheld for sampled long states and for the unstable iOS C06 initial state. Additional direct native screenshot/crops confirmed notes clipping.
narrowSupportedObservations: The examined normal-size frames show content and actions in natural card flow, without a visible fixed footer. Card width and outer position samples match offered margins within native fractional rounding.

The examined selected choices use distinct accent borders/tints and indicators; RTL samples mirror item tiles, option indicators, notes chevrons and amount alignment. These are visual observations for the listed images, not full directional acceptance.

classicalFalsePositiveRate.reason: Snapshot/check counts and broad coverage summaries do not enumerate a validated independent reviewed-negative atomic denominator. No zero denominator is reported as zero percent.

scopePolicy.platformNames: Exact own D0 names android and apple. Original ios strings remain verbatim in preserved findings.
scopePolicy.broadFindings: No automatic expansion into unnamed parameterized controls, text or token members.
scopePolicy.uncertainty: An unknown/unassessed/suspected or non-product observation never becomes a confirmed TP/FP. Same-condition adequately supported contradiction is required for FP.
scopePolicy.findingClassification: TP_ONLY/FP_ONLY/MIXED describe resolved exact atomic claims, with all unresolved subclaims retained separately; MIXED requires both TP and FP. UNCERTAIN has no resolved confirmed product claim; NO_CONFIRMED_CLAIM includes explicit productViolationClaimed=false.
scopePolicy.independence: Sequential own-review comparisons, procedural blindness on shared filesystem; no OS isolation claim.
